## AI slop check

**Result:** 5 phrases read as AI-written, in a draft of three sentences. Each is marked below with a suggested fix.

### What to change

| # | Your text | Suggested fix | Why it reads as AI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | "It's not just about writing faster — it's about writing better." | State the claim directly: "AI makes writing faster, not necessarily better." | False contrast: nobody argued for "faster" alone |
| 2 | "Moreover," | Cut it: the next sentence stands on its own | Filler transition: it can go with nothing lost |
